script: At the heart of our galaxy is a supermassive black hole. It has the mass of about four million Suns. It is about 26,000 light-years away from us. Astronomers released the first picture of it in 2022. They found it by watching stars whip around an invisible object at the center. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
